I validated round 1 end to end. Summary:

**Coverage** — I enumerated the questions from the source myself (slide deck pages 7–11 through all three channels, plus the notebook in full, which specs.md names as the real spec). The deliverable is four TODOs, a DeepWalk/node2vec reproduction, at least one own sampling strategy, the `comparison_table()` comparison with the "which task does each help" analysis, and optional Task 4. All nine items are answered; nothing uncovered.

**Correctness** — I re-ran the pipeline from my own copy of the code and reproduced three runs **bit-exactly**: Task 3 `deepwalk` and `triadic` at seed 0, and Task 4 `metapath U-U-U-A-U` at seed 0, all 13 columns each. I also re-derived every dataset statistic from the raw CSVs (7,624 users, 666 isolated, 734 components, bucket sizes 216/266/469/842/939/1439, 3,014,361 user–artist edges, artists-per-user median 400, …), re-ran the corpus/token accounting, the meta-path type-correctness tests, the rare-artist 613→204.5 measurement, the 0.72% type-blind social-step probe, and the cold-start coverage numbers. All exact. I recomputed every noise floor and spread/noise ratio in Table 1 independently (7.0/6.0/4.1/4.2/1.3/5.4/1.7/3.9×) — all correct. I spot-checked the load-bearing interpretive claim too: 87.5% of edges join same-country users vs 11.9% at chance, so "extremely assortative" holds.

**The PDF** — recompiled cleanly (14 pages, zero overfull boxes, no duplicate labels, no undefined refs), all four figures render as vector, are legible, and agree with the tables they plot; the 9-column tables stay inside the margins. Fragments are byte-identical to the worker deliverables, labels and listing styles are namespaced, preamble correctly de-duplicated.

**Three minor defects**, none blocking: "Seven rules are compared" over a five-row table; two table captions attributing the `val ma-F1` column to `comparison_table()` when `run_experiment` does not record it; and the Task 3 block being reprinted inside Table 4 (notebook-sanctioned, recorded rather than objected to).

Checklist appended at `playground/cse60745_20260923_8654c1/validator/checklist.md`.

VERDICT: PASS
